transcript.speaker: Derek Osei
transcript.text: How are you feeling about the team's bandwidth heading into the SSO project?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Honestly, a little stretched. Jae-won's carrying most of the backend load between SSO and normal maintenance, and Sofia's split between SSO wireframes and onboarding polish.

transcript.speaker: Derek Osei
transcript.text: Do you think we need to hire, or is this a temporary crunch?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: I think we could use one more backend engineer, especially once SSO ramps up. It's not urgent-urgent, but I'd rather raise it now than in month two of the project when it's a fire.

transcript.speaker: Derek Osei
transcript.text: Let's open a req. Can you draft the role description this week so I can review it?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Yes, I'll have a draft ready by Friday.

transcript.speaker: Derek Osei
transcript.text: On a separate note - how are you feeling about your own growth? Last time we talked you mentioned wanting more exposure to cross-team planning.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: I've gotten some of that through the Q3 roadmap session, which was useful. I'd like more of it, maybe eventually owning a roadmap area end to end rather than just contributing to Jae-won's or others' plans.

transcript.speaker: Derek Osei
transcript.text: That's a fair ask given where you are. Let's target having you own the SSO roadmap area end to end as a concrete example, starting now, not just contributing to it.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: I'd like that a lot, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Derek Osei
transcript.text: One thing I want your read on - Tomasz mentioned in passing he's interested in moving toward more automation and tooling work rather than pure manual QA. Have you sensed that too?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: A little, yeah. I haven't had a direct conversation with him about it though.

transcript.speaker: Derek Osei
transcript.text: Could you check in with him this week and get a clearer sense of what he wants? I don't want to lose him to another team looking for that if we could offer it here.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Good idea, I'll set up time with him this week.

summary_key_points: The backend team is stretched thin between SSO and regular maintenance, and hiring one more engineer is being considered
Priya will own the SSO roadmap area end to end as a growth opportunity
Tomasz may be interested in moving toward automation and tooling work
Priya will check in with Tomasz this week to understand his career interests
